title: It's the luck of the draw on what kind of piece you get. I got a bad one.
text:
It's the luck of the draw on what kind of piece you get. I got a bad one.. I returned this item. It was as small as allowed by the description, and an ugly cut where there wasn't a good display surface anywhere. If it'd been larger and a bad cut, or small but a nice piece I'd have been happy. Unfortunately being small AND ugly I didn't think it was worth the price.

Of course, what piece you get is up to the luck of the draw, so you might have better luck than me.
